blocks.head: alt The cloud associates UserX with the device and UserX has no key yet
alt UserX and the device exist
alt UserY is a member of UserX and both are associated with the same device in the cloud

state_rules.rule:
eq < system | ('counter' : N , ..) > < UserX | ('key' : nils , ...) > < cloudA | (UserX : ('device' : deviceB , ....) , .....) > $ UserX 'openWindow' cloudA | (deviceB) 
= < system | ('counter' : N + 1 , ..) > < UserX | ('key' : randomStr('KeyA', N) , ...) > < cloudA | (UserX : ('device' : deviceB , ....) , .....) > $ cloudA 'openWindow' deviceB | (randomStr('KeyA', N)) .

eq < system | ('counter' : N , ..) > < deviceB | ('key' : nils , ...) > $ cloudA 'openWindow' deviceB | (FreshKeyA) 
= < system | ('counter' : N + 1 , ..) > < deviceB | ('key' : randomStr('KeyA', N) , ...) > .

ceq < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > < deviceB | ('key' : DeviceKey , 'trusted' : TrustedUsers , ...) > $ UserX 'bind' deviceB | (Key) 
= < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > < deviceB | ('key' : DeviceKey , 'trusted' : (UserX , TrustedUsers) , ...) > if Key == DeviceKey .

eq < deviceB | ('trusted' : (UserX , TrustedUsers) , 'on' : false , ..) > $ UserX 'turnOn' deviceB 
= < deviceB | ('trusted' : (UserX , TrustedUsers) , 'on' : true , ..) > .

eq < cloudA | (UserX : ('device' : deviceB , ..) , ...) > $ UserX 'turnOn' cloudA | (deviceB) 
= < cloudA | (UserX : ('device' : deviceB , ..) , ...) > $ cloudA 'turnOn' deviceB .

eq < deviceB | ('trusted' : (cloudA , TrustedUsers) , 'on' : false , ..) > $ cloudA 'turnOn' deviceB 
= < deviceB | ('trusted' : (cloudA , TrustedUsers) , 'on' : true , ..) > .

eq < cloudA | (UserX : ('members' : Members , ..) , ...) > $ UserX 'invite' cloudA | (UserY) 
= < cloudA | (UserX : ('members' : (UserY , Members) , ..) , ...) > .

eq < cloudA | (UserX : ('device' : deviceB , ..) , UserY : ('device' : nils , ...) , ....) > $ UserX 'invite' cloudA | (UserY) 
= < cloudA | (UserX : ('device' : deviceB , ..) , UserY : ('device' : deviceB , ...) , ....) > .

eq < cloudA | (UserX : ('members' : (UserY , Members) , 'device' : deviceB , ..) , UserY : ('device' : deviceB , ...) , ....) > $ UserX 'removeMember' cloudA | (UserY) 
= < cloudA | (UserX : ('members' : Members , 'device' : deviceB , ..) , UserY : ('device' : nils , ...) , ....) > .

event_rules.label: rev1
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev1]: E @ S < UserX | ('key' : nils , ..) > < cloudA | (UserX : ('device' : deviceB , ...) , ....) > 
=> ep: ev1(UserX) @ S < UserX | ('key' : nils , ..) > < cloudA | (UserX : ('device' : deviceB , ...) , ....) > .

event_rules.label: rev2
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev2]: E @ S < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > 
=> ep: ev2(UserX, Key) @ S < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev3
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev3]: E @ S < UserX | (..) > < deviceB | (...) > 
=> ep: ev3(UserX) @ S < UserX | (..) > < deviceB | (...) > .

event_rules.label: rev4
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev4]: E @ S < UserX | (..) > < UserY | (...) > 
=> ep: ev4(UserX, UserY) @ S < UserX | (..) > < UserY | (...) > .
